rows.jyutping: A ge3 ji3 si1 hai6 B
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “signify” means that a word, sign, or action means something.

example.english: This red light can signify that we must stop.
example.traditional: 呢個紅燈嘅意思係要停低。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 hung4 dang1 ge3 ji3 si1 hai6 jiu3 ting4 dai1

rows.note: Use this when someone deliberately indicates or announces an intention, attitude, or decision.

example.english: They raised their hand to signify opposition.
example.jyutping: keoi5 geoi2 sau2 biu2 si6 faan2 deoi3

rows.note: Use this in questions or negative statements about whether something makes a difference.

example.english: Does it signify anything whether you come or not?
example.jyutping: nei5 lai4 m4 lai4 jau5 mou5 fan1 bit6 aa3
